title: Refresh button for the Claude screen's usage meters
notes: The Claude screen's status line (context meter, 5h/7d usage, cache warm) is measured after each turn, so it can look stale between turns. Add a small refresh icon beside the usage meters that re-asks for context usage and plan usage now (the same calls measureOf uses), spinning while it runs and ignoring presses during a read. Keyboard first: a key (a row in src/shared/keys/actions.ts) does the same. A failure shows the usual notice line and keeps the last numbers. Help within BLURB_WORD_LIMIT, docs/chat updated.
